paragraphs: My favorite book is The Little Hospital. It has many pictures, and I look at them every day. Three people are in the book. Shall I tell you about them? The first person is Nurse Alice. She is twenty-five years old. She has short blond hair. Her eyes are green. She is not tall. She wears a white coat and a yellow scarf round her neck. She is a nurse at the hospital. She always smiles at the sick children.

The second person is Doctor Mark. He is forty years old, and he is very tall. His hair is gray. He has a long beard. His eyes are brown. He wears round glasses and a blue sweater. Doctor Mark has a kind face. He helps many sick people every day. He looks at a child and says, "Don't worry. You are fine!"

The third person is a small boy. He is eight years old, and he is sick. He has a headache and a temperature. The boy's hair is black and curly. His eyes are big and brown. He is small, and he wears a blue shirt. The boy is in the hospital, but he is not afraid. A small red ball is on his bed. Alice and Mark are in his room all day. Alice and Mark help him, and he is better after one day. Which person do you like? Do you have a favorite book?
text.summary: Mia tells us about her favorite picture book. She describes the three people in it: a nurse, a doctor, and a sick boy.
